description: Certified inclusions between graph families with fixed auxiliary parameters. Upper bounds restrict to subclasses. Only edges with lower=true are used for lower bounds; unspecified excluded-minor choices are not transferred backwards. Other theorem assumptions and instance domains remain in force.

nodes.label: General
nodes.description: All finite graphs; other theorem assumptions still apply.

nodes.label: Bounded arboricity
nodes.description: Equivalent boundedness families: bounded arboricity, degeneracy and maximum average degree, with parameter changes. A numerical bound is retained in the source.

nodes.label: Bounded depth-one density
nodes.description: Bounded maximum average degree and depth-one shallow-minor density.

nodes.label: Bounded expansion
nodes.description: A fixed expansion function bounds shallow-minor density at each depth.

nodes.label: Sub-logarithmic expansion
nodes.description: Expansion f(r)=o(log r); this includes every fixed-minor-free family.

nodes.label: Minor-free
nodes.description: Algorithms here quantify over every fixed excluded minor H. An inclusion may require choosing H; lower bounds are not universal in arbitrary H.

nodes.label: H-minor-free; pw(H) ≤ 2
aliases: H-minor-free with excluded minor of pathwidth at most 2
nodes.description: Graphs excluding a fixed graph H whose pathwidth is at most 2. The pathwidth condition is on the excluded minor H, not on the input graph; the input graph can have arbitrarily large pathwidth.

nodes.label: Pₜ-minor-free
nodes.description: Graphs excluding the path on t vertices as a minor, for fixed t. Every connected component has bounded diameter; disconnected inputs are handled componentwise.

nodes.label: Excluded topological minor
nodes.description: A fixed excluded clique subdivision; the bound may depend on its size.

nodes.label: Euler genus ≤ g
nodes.description: A fixed Euler-genus bound g, including nonorientable surfaces.

nodes.label: Bounded orientable genus
nodes.description: A fixed orientable-genus bound; kept distinct from Euler genus.

nodes.label: Locally embeddable
nodes.description: Bounded depth-one density and exclusion of a depth-one K3,t minor, as defined in the source.

nodes.label: Asymptotic dimension d; radius-r balls of Euler genus ≤ g
aliases: Asymptotic dimension d; r-locally Euler genus ≤ g
Asymptotic dimension d; sufficiently large-radius neighborhoods of Euler genus ≤ g
nodes.description: Graph classes of asymptotic dimension d with a fixed control function, where every induced radius-r ball has Euler genus at most g for a sufficiently large fixed radius r.

nodes.label: Asymptotic dimension d; radius-r balls of Euler genus ≤ g with at most a apices
aliases: Asymptotic dimension d; r-locally Euler genus ≤ g with at most a apices
nodes.description: Graph classes of asymptotic dimension at most d with a fixed dimensional control function, where deleting at most a vertices from each induced radius-r ball leaves Euler genus at most g, for a sufficiently large fixed radius r. This is a local condition and does not assert global minor exclusion.

nodes.label: Bounded genus with apices
nodes.description: Bounded Euler genus after deleting a bounded number of apex vertices.

nodes.label: Planar with an attached clique
nodes.description: A planar graph with a clique glued at one vertex; includes the trivial one-vertex clique.

nodes.label: Planar
nodes.description: Graphs admitting a crossing-free drawing in the plane.

nodes.label: Outerplanar
nodes.description: Planar graphs admitting an embedding with every vertex on the outer face.

nodes.label: Triangle-free planar
nodes.description: Planar graphs with no triangles.

nodes.label: Planar without 4-cycles
nodes.description: Planar graphs without cycles of length four.

nodes.label: Trees / forests
nodes.description: Acyclic graphs. Connectivity is retained where required by a theorem.

nodes.label: Paths
nodes.description: Simple paths, without a supplied orientation.

nodes.label: Oriented paths
nodes.description: Paths with a supplied orientation; retain that additional information in lower-bound statements.

nodes.label: Cycles
nodes.description: Simple cycles.

nodes.label: Long cycles
nodes.description: Cycles satisfying the theorem’s length threshold.

nodes.label: Bounded degree
nodes.description: Maximum degree is bounded by a fixed auxiliary parameter.

nodes.label: Bounded-degree trees
nodes.description: Trees with a bounded maximum degree.

nodes.label: Bipartite
nodes.description: Graphs admitting a proper two-coloring; the coloring is not automatically supplied as input.

nodes.label: Degree-3 bipartite
nodes.description: Bipartite graphs of maximum degree at most three.

nodes.label: Weakly 2-colored
nodes.description: Graphs with a supplied weak two-coloring and the source’s isolate restriction.

nodes.label: Unit-disk
nodes.description: Intersection graphs of equal-radius disks in the plane; density can be unbounded.

nodes.label: Polynomial neighborhood-independence growth
nodes.description: Polynomial growth of independent sets in neighborhoods, rather than vertex-volume growth.

nodes.label: K₂,t-minor-free
nodes.description: Graphs excluding K₂,t as a minor for a fixed integer t≥2. Since pw(K₂,t)=2, these are included in the H-minor-free family with pw(H)≤2 by taking H=K₂,t.

nodes.label: Minor-free with domination constraint
nodes.description: Excluded clique minor plus the theorem’s γ₁(G) ≤ Cγₖ(G) condition.

nodes.label: Linklessly embeddable
nodes.description: Graphs with a linkless embedding in three dimensions.

nodes.label: No K₄,₄ subdivision
nodes.description: Graphs containing no subdivision of K4,4.

nodes.label: Triangle-free; Euler genus ≤ g
nodes.description: Triangle-free graphs of Euler genus at most g.

nodes.label: High-girth bounded expansion
nodes.description: Bounded expansion together with the source’s girth ≥ 4r+2 or 4r+3 threshold.

nodes.label: High-girth k-hop expansion
nodes.description: The source’s k-hop expansion bound and girth ≥4k+3, including connectivity where stated.

nodes.label: No short odd cycles
nodes.description: No odd cycles of lengths 3,5,…,2k−1 for the stated k.

nodes.label: Powers of paths
nodes.description: r-th powers of paths for fixed r. The whole parameterized family is not planar.

nodes.label: Path powers with endpoint leaves
nodes.description: Path powers with additional leaves at one endpoint, as in the thesis construction.

nodes.label: Arboricity at most 2
nodes.description: The fixed arboricity-two family; it contains nonplanar graphs.

nodes.label: Incidence graphs
nodes.description: Variable–constraint or set–element incidence graphs; an instance-domain restriction.

nodes.label: Planar incidence graphs
nodes.description: Planar incidence graphs; the graph is also bipartite.

nodes.label: Bounded set size and frequency
nodes.description: Incidence instances with bounded set size and element frequency.

nodes.label: Bounded treewidth
nodes.description: Graphs of bounded treewidth; the parameter remains fixed.

nodes.label: Bounded pathwidth
nodes.description: Graphs of bounded pathwidth; the parameter remains fixed.

nodes.label: K₁,ₜ-minor-free
nodes.description: Graphs excluding the fixed star K1,t as a minor. Their maximum degree is at most t−1; bounded degree alone does not exclude a large star minor.

nodes.label: Regular
nodes.description: Every vertex has the same degree. A result may additionally require a positive degree; the degree need not be bounded independently of n.

nodes.label: Pseudoforests
nodes.description: Every connected component has at most one cycle. Forests are a proper subclass; each pseudoforest is outerplanar.

Arboricity ≤ α.note: Use compatible fixed arboricity bounds; planar inputs permit an arboricity bound of 3.

Arboricity β ≥ 1.note: Use compatible fixed arboricity bounds; planar inputs permit an arboricity bound of 3.

Bounded arboricity.note: Use compatible fixed arboricity bounds; planar inputs permit an arboricity bound of 3.

Excluded fixed minor.note: The excluded minor or minor-density bound is a fixed parameter; instantiate it compatibly with the target class.

Excluded Kₕ minor.note: The excluded minor or minor-density bound is a fixed parameter; instantiate it compatibly with the target class.

Proper minor-closed classes.note: The excluded minor or minor-density bound is a fixed parameter; instantiate it compatibly with the target class.

H-minor-free graphs.note: The excluded minor or minor-density bound is a fixed parameter; instantiate it compatibly with the target class.

Every minor H satisfies |E(H)| ≤ a|V(H)|.note: The excluded minor or minor-density bound is a fixed parameter; instantiate it compatibly with the target class.

Every minor H satisfies |E(H)| ≤ ρ|V(H)|.note: The excluded minor or minor-density bound is a fixed parameter; instantiate it compatibly with the target class.

Isolate-free; every minor H has |E(H)| ≤.note: Requires an isolate-free instance, as appropriate for total domination.

Bounded Euler genus.note: Retain any connectivity condition stated by the source.

Connected graphs of Euler genus ≤ g.note: Retain any connectivity condition stated by the source.

Euler genus ≤ e.note: Retain any connectivity condition stated by the source.

Euler genus ≤ g.note: Retain any connectivity condition stated by the source.

Bounded genus.note: The historical record does not establish applicability to every bounded Euler-genus family.

Bounded orientable genus g.note: The historical record does not establish applicability to every bounded Euler-genus family.

Orientable genus ≤ g.note: The historical record does not establish applicability to every bounded Euler-genus family.

Asymptotic dimension d; r-locally Euler.note: Asymptotic dimension, its control function and sufficiently large local radius remain fixed prerequisites.

Asymptotic dimension d; sufficiently lar.note: Asymptotic dimension, its control function and sufficiently large local radius remain fixed prerequisites.

Oriented paths.note: Orientation is supplied to the lower-bound algorithm.

Weakly 2-coloured graphs.note: Requires a supplied weak two-coloring and no isolated vertices.

Polynomially bounded growth.note: Growth refers to independent sets in neighborhoods, not vertex counts.

Kₜ-minor-free; γ₁(G) ≤ Cγₖ(G).note: Requires the stated relation between domination numbers.

Bounded expansion; girth ≥ 4r + 2.note: The girth threshold remains required for the stated distance parameter.

Expansion f; girth ≥ 4r + 3.note: The girth threshold remains required for the stated distance parameter.

Connected; k-hop expansion ≤ f(k); girth.note: Retains connectivity, the precise k-hop expansion definition, and girth threshold.

General incidence graphs.note: The communication graph is the variable–constraint incidence graph.

Planar incidence graph.note: Planarity is required of the incidence graph.

Incidence graphs; set size ≤ k, frequenc.note: The set-size and frequency bounds remain required.

Regular; degree ≥ 1.note: The vertex-cover baseline assumes a positive regular degree. It does not select all vertices of a nonempty edgeless graph.

Pseudoforests.note: The one-round non-leaf construction extends to this class by the elementary star-assignment proof in the result details.

H-minor-free; pw(H) ≤ 2.note: H is a fixed excluded minor with pw(H) ≤ 2; the input graph need not have pathwidth at most 2.

Pₜ-minor-free.note: t is the fixed number of vertices of the excluded path. Bounds apply separately to each connected component.

Asymptotic dimension d; radius-r balls o.note: Retain fixed d, g, a, a sufficiently large radius r, and the class-dimensional control function; the deletion set of at most a apices may differ between balls.

Degeneracy ≤ d.note: Retain the stated numerical degeneracy bound d. Boundedness is equivalent to bounded arboricity, but their numerical parameters are not identified.
